items.platform-dashboard: Tenants, live subscriptions, MRR (Σ plan monthly price at seats), invoices due/overdue, this month's leads, licences expiring — every tile from SaasPlatform::dashboard() over the platform-wide store.
items.tenants: The customer book: code, name, GST state, domain, status; plan and employee count read through a store scoped to each tenant. Suspend / reactivate are status moves, never deletes.
items.plans: Name, base price per month for the included employees, extra-employee price, default cycle, status, and the modules the plan unlocks ticked from the module registry into the features JSON.
items.subscriptions: Tenant × plan × seats × cycle; the amount is computed (plan monthly price × cycle months). Renew moves the period on by one cycle; Cancel keeps the row.
items.invoices: Raised per subscription with GST from config/gst.json — CGST+SGST for the home state, IGST elsewhere — numbered prefix-year-sequence; Mark paid records the payment and settles it.
items.payments: Every payment, gateway or manual, against its invoice with mode and reference; a succeeded payment settles the invoice when the balance reaches zero.
items.gateways: A register of gateway credentials — gateway, test/live, key and secret as password fields, webhook URL, status.
items.feature-flags: Keys declared in config/feature-flags.json; a global row or a per-tenant row overrides the default, resolved tenant → global → default.
items.admin-leads: Website enquiries with source and a New → Contacted → Closed pipeline (config/leads.json), notes, one-tap call/WhatsApp/email, live-demo entries beneath, and Convert to tenant.
items.admin-quotations: Plan × seats × cycle months, less a coupon (validated) or a typed discount, plus GST for the buyer's state, valid till a date; Accept creates the tenant and its subscription at the quoted figures.
items.admin-coupons: Campaign codes: percent or flat, a valid window, max uses and a used count written only by redemption, plan/cycle/context rules — a register with unique codes.
items.admin-staff: Every login of the operator's tenant whose role holds tenant.settings.update — the people who can see every tenant. Managed in User Management.
items.admin-onprem: Perpetual-licence clients: price, AMC %, payments against the price, licence keys (hash + last four kept, key shown once), servers, events, Extend AMC and Revoke.
items.admin-releases: A version with notes, published on a date, granted to on-prem clients who report back what they applied; the cloud's own version is config/version.json.
